title: Partner representation audit for allelic heterogeneity
description: Frozen code, derived results, cohort specifications and source data for the staged audit of partner-aware protein representations. Original structural disruption verdict NO_GO_EDGETIC_REPRESENTATION; sequence arm PARTIAL_SEQUENCE_RESCUE; phenotype test NO_GLOBAL_PARTNER_IDENTITY_SUPPORT. No new analysis was performed during archival preparation.
